_notes.uriBase: Must be a public origin. Wallets and explorers fetch token metadata from their own servers, so localhost resolves to nothing for everyone but you.
_notes.stocks: Mainnet xStock mints (Token-2022). They do not exist on devnet — `npm run stocks` mints stand-ins there.
_notes.pump: npm run fees -- --setup --send (once, creator key) makes pump.fun split fees on-chain holderBps/rest between potWallet and protocolWallet; distribute is then permissionless and the cycle does it. potWallet = pot-wallet.json pubkey.
